Hulbury


TrainersPokemonItems


Wild Area?: No
South Exit: Route 5
East Exit: Galar Mine No. 2
Access To: Route 10, Wedgehurst, Meetup Spot, Hammerlocke, Motostoke, Wyndon

Hulbury is a coastal town in the south east part of Galar. It features The Captain's Table, a valued restaurant as well as docks for boats, a lighthouse where The Maximizers will sometimes play and a market in the south of town

Gym
The Hulbury Gym features a puzzle where you have to get through the gym by altering the flow of water through various coloued pipes
